rationale: Behaviour versus stated rule. Every Alex G source states the setup condition as price reaching a level - the confirmation 'has to be at a support level', and away from one the rule is 'simply not applicable'. Here a setup is declined because price came roughly 10 pips SHORT of the level, which is a different and unstated condition: a proximity tolerance. No source in the library gives a tolerance, a maximum acceptable distance, or a rule for near-misses. The taught rule is binary; the demonstrated behaviour is graded. Recorded, not resolved - MOGO must not invent the threshold.
